title: Misc Patches
description: Small, independent fixes for things other modules and the platform get slightly wrong at the table, each behind its own setting. Old effect keys reach their new fields: dnd5e 6.0 redirects an effect written against a moved key only one step, so a key that moved twice (the PHB's Roving: a 35-foot speed read 3510) lands on the wrong field; each redirect is followed to its end.
